column3: So how much of your life is made of habits?
In one diary study, between a third and a half of what students did were things they did almost every day, usually in the same place.
That's the real lesson of Solo Leveling. The day Jinwoo says, arise, didn't come out of nowhere. It was built out of hundreds of ordinary mornings nobody saw.
So here's your daily quest. Pick one small thing. Decide exactly when you'll do it. Track it. And if you miss a day, come back the next one.
Give it sixty six days. Then tell me how it went.
Comment your daily quest below. And which anime should we level up next?
